See also: classé and clâsse

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin classis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ˈkla.sə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ˈkla.se]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

classe f (plural classes)

  1. class; kind
    Synonyms: tipus, mena
  2. class; elegance
  3. class (a group of students)
  4. class; lesson
  5. class (a course of study covering a series of related lessons)
  6. classroom
    Synonym: aula
  7. (taxonomy) class
  8. (transport) class
  9. (military) class

Derived terms

[edit]
  • classe social
  • classejar
  • classificar
  • classisme
  • classista

Related terms

[edit]
  • clàssic

Further reading

[edit]
  • “classe”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “classe”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “classe” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “classe” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin classis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /klas/ ~ /klɑs/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Canada):(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Audio (Switzerland (Valais)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Toulouse)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Hérault)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Saint-Étienne)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

classe f (plural classes)

  1. class, type, group
  2. (military) class, cohort (all the recruits conscripted in a particular year)
  3. (military, in the plural) a period of military training
  4. (object-oriented programming) class

      Hindi: क्लास (klās)

  • → Franco-Provençal: cllâsse

Italian

Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
classe
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin classis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈklas.se/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -asse
  • Hyphenation: clàs‧se

Noun

[edit]

classe f (plural classi)

  1. (computing, mathematics, semantics, taxonomy) class (all senses)
  2. classroom
  3. style
  4. grade

Derived terms

[edit]
  • classare
  • classificare
  • classismo
  • classista
  • fuoriclasse

Related terms

[edit]

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin classis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈkla.si/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈkla.si/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈkla.se/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈkla.sɨ/

  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: clas‧se

Noun

[edit]

classe f (plural classes)

  1. class, kind (group, collection, category or set sharing characteristics or attributes)
    Synonyms: categoria, grupo, divisão, classificação
  2. class; elegance
    Synonym: elegância
  3. class (a group of students)
  4. class; lesson
    Synonym: aula
  5. classroom
    Synonym: sala de aula
  6. (taxonomy) class

Derived terms

[edit]
  • classe gramatical

Related terms

[edit]
  • classificar, classificação, classificado, classificador
  • classista, clássico

Further reading

[edit]
  • “classe”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “classe”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026
